description: This file contains the PHP class implementation for a Blog module controller in the OpenCart system, defining methods for handling blog article listings, image processing, and view rendering within the OpenCart extension.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for handling blog articles in the OpenCart extension, extending the system's base Controller class and providing an index method for listing blog articles with image handling and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load language, models, prepare data, fetch articles, process images, and render the blog listing view.
